title: Tile and Stone Adhesive
intro: Our tile and stone adhesives are advanced bonding solutions designed to securely fix tiles and stones to walls and floors. They provide strong, long-lasting adhesion, reduce cracking or lifting, and ensure a smooth, durable, and visually appealing finish for residential, commercial, and industrial projects.

products.name: Weberset Firm White
products.description: Weberset Firm is a high-performance, polymer-modified tile adhesive designed for fixing natural stones, vitrified tiles, and mosaics on both interior and exterior surfaces. It offers superior adhesion, no sag application, water resistance, and suitability for heavy-duty and high temperature areas like pools and spas. Ideal for projects requiring strong bonding and extended workability. Perfect for professional tile installation with ISO 13007 C2TE compliance.

products.name: Weber Set Firm 30
products.description: Weberset Firm is a polymer-modified, high-bond tile adhesive ideal for fixing vitrified tiles, natural stones, and mosaics on interior and exterior surfaces. It ensures excellent adhesion, no vertical slip, and high resistance to water and temperature changes. Suitable for bathrooms, kitchens, facades, and swimming pools, with ISO 13007 C2TE certification.

products.name: Weber Set Flex
products.description: Weberset Flex is a high-performance, polymer-modified tile adhesive ideal for marble, granite, mosaics, and natural stones on vibration-prone surfaces. Suitable for both indoor and outdoor use, it ensures superior bonding with no sag, long open time, and excellent water resistance. Perfect for swimming pools, kitchens, bathrooms, and façade cladding. Conforms to ISO 13007 C2TES1 and ANSI A118.15 standards.

products.name: Weber Set Nova
products.description: Weberset Nova is a high-performance, polymer-modified thinset tile adhesive designed for vitrified tiles and natural stone. Suitable for internal and external use, it offers superior bond strength, sag resistance, and low VOC. Ideal for dry and wet areas, Weberset Nova ensures hassle-free tile application with excellent workability and extended open time. Perfect for renovation and new construction projects.

products.name: Weber Set Plus White
products.description: Weberset Plus White is a highly polymer-modified, white tile adhesive ideal for fixing natural stones, vitrified, and ceramic tiles on walls and floors. Its superior bonding, non-slip properties, and aesthetic white finish make it perfect for interiors, exteriors, wet areas, and window jambs. Suitable for up to 15 mm thickness, it complies with ISO 13007 C2T and IS 15477 Type 2 standards.

products.name: Weber Set Premier
products.description: Weberset Premier is a polymer-modified, C1T-classified thinset tile adhesive, ideal for fixing ceramic, terracotta, and quarry tiles on internal walls and floors. With low VOC, no-sag formula, and high durability, it ensures easy application and strong bonding. Conforms to ISO 13007, IS 15477:2019, and ANSI A118.1 standards, making it perfect for residential and commercial tile installations.

products.name: Weber Set Ultra White
products.description: Weberset Ultra is a premium two-component tile adhesive ideal for fixing natural, impregnated, and composite stones, especially for wall cladding. Its no-sag, high-grab formula ensures strong vertical and horizontal bonding on internal and external surfaces. Highly polymer-modified with low VOC, it offers extended open time and superior adhesion, making it perfect for heavy-duty applications. Ideal for both new construction and renovation projects.

products.name: Weber Color Fine
products.description: Weber Color Fine is a polymer-modified, cement-based tile grout designed for filling tile joints up to 3 mm. It offers smooth, water-resistant, and stain-resistant finishes for both wall and floor tiles. Ideal for ceramic, vitrified, and natural stone tiles in kitchens, bathrooms, and commercial areas. Available in a wide range of colors to match modern tile designs.

products.name: Weber Tile Grout
products.description: Weber Tile Grout is a cement-based, polymer-modified grout ideal for wall and floor joints from 2 to 8 mm. Suitable for interior and exterior use in wet or dry areas like kitchens and bathrooms, it offers excellent bonding, smooth finish, and water resistance. Available in 17 vibrant shades including Grey, Ivory, Jet Black, White, Mushroom, Jaisalmer, Terracotta, and more—perfect for seamless tile aesthetics.

products.name: Weber Drywall
products.description: Weberset Drywall is a lightweight, polymer-modified tile adhesive specially formulated for fixing tiles, stone, and mosaics on drywall, gypsum boards, and fiber cement boards. It offers high bond strength, no sag, and excellent workability—ideal for quick and secure tile installations in dry internal environments. Perfect for homes, offices, and commercial interiors.

products.name: Weber Epoxy Filler
products.description: Weber.joint poxy combined with poxyfill is a premium 100% solid epoxy grout system designed for high-performance tile and stone installations. This chemical-resistant, stain-proof, and water-resistant grout is ideal for residential, commercial, and industrial settings. Available in over 40 attractive shades including AL-PINE BLUE, GRAPHITE, and TUSCAN WHITE, it's perfect for hygiene-sensitive and high-traffic areas. Conforms to ISO 13007 and ANSI 118.3 standards, offering superior durability and easy maintenance.

products.name: Weber Joint Poxy
products.description: Weber Joint Poxy is a high-performance, 100% solid epoxy grout engineered for maximum stain, chemical, and abrasion resistance in tile and stone joints. Ideal for wet and dry areas, it resists bacterial growth and supports joint widths from 2 mm to 14 mm. Available in premium shades like Grey, Snow White, Ivory, Chocolate, Misty Grey, De-Sareo, Frost, Moss Green, and Osario—perfect for both aesthetic and industrial applications.

products.name: Weberfix PU
products.description: Weberfix PU is a two-component polyurethane tile adhesive ideal for metal, drywall, plywood, and PU-coated surfaces. It delivers high bond strength, flexibility, and moisture resistance. Perfect for tile-on-tile, exterior façades, and deformable substrates. Conforms to ISO 13007 (R2T) standards for durable, long-lasting adhesion.

products.name: Weberset Wonder
products.description: Weberset Wonder is a polymer-modified tile adhesive ideal for ceramic, vitrified, and natural stone tiles. Suitable for wet and dry areas, it offers strong bonding, sag resistance, and tile-on-tile application. Perfect for internal and external walls and floors in residential and commercial spaces.

products.name: Weber Easy Epoxy
products.description: Weberepox easy is a premium, two-component epoxy tile adhesive and grout offering superior chemical resistance, high compressive strength, and easy water cleanability. Ideal for bathrooms, kitchens, swimming pools, and industrial zones, it ensures anti-bacterial, stain-free, and non-sag performance. Perfect for high-traffic and corrosive environments.

products.name: Weber Knight Armor
products.description: Weber Knight Armor is a high-performance, cementitious waterproof wall putty designed to protect surfaces from water seepage and efflorescence. It offers excellent bonding, smooth finish, and UV resistance, making it ideal for exterior and interior applications. Suitable for plaster, concrete, and masonry surfaces in both residential and commercial projects.

products.name: Weberfix PU Hiflex
products.description: Weberfix PU Hiflex is a high-performance, two-component polyurethane adhesive ideal for fixing large and thin tiles on challenging substrates like metal, glass, drywall, and PU-coated surfaces. Its R2T classification ensures superior bond strength, flexibility, and chemical resistance, even under thermal stress. Perfect for internal and external cladding on high-rise buildings without spacers. Ideal solution for demanding tile and stone applications.

products.name: Weber Nova Plus Grey
products.description: Weberset Nova Plus is a high-performance, polymer-modified tile adhesive ideal for vitrified tiles, ceramic tiles, and natural stones. Suitable for both internal and external areas, it provides strong bonding, extended open time, and resistance to moisture. Perfect for floors and walls in residential and commercial applications.

products.name: Weber Set Glass Mosaic
products.description: Weber.set Glass Mosaic is a premium, polymer-modified white tile adhesive specially designed for fixing glass mosaics in swimming pools, kitchens, and wet areas. Offering high bond strength, water resistance, and slip resistance, it's ideal for vertical and horizontal surfaces. With its fine particle size and extended open time, this adhesive ensures brilliant color enhancement and hassle-free installation for mosaic tiles. Perfect for high moisture environments, it complies with ISO 13007, EN12004, and ANSI A118.15 standards.

products.name: Weber Flex Grey
products.description: Weberset Flex is a high-performance, polymer-modified tile adhesive ideal for marble, granite, vitrified, and low-porosity tiles. Engineered to withstand substrate vibration, it offers superior flexibility, water resistance, and heat aging performance. Perfect for interior and exterior tiling, it conforms to ISO 13007 C2TES1 and IS 15477:2004 standards. Ideal for use in swimming pools, kitchens, saunas, and facades.

products.name: Weberset Classic
products.description: Weberset Classic is a polymer-modified tile adhesive designed for ceramic and vitrified tile-on-tile applications in indoor wet and dry areas. It provides excellent bond strength, anti-sag performance, and easy workability with a 3–15 mm bed thickness. Ideal for residential flooring, bathroom walls, and renovation projects, with low VOC emissions and ISO 13007 C1TE certification.

products.name: Akemi Stone Cleaner
products.description: AKEMI® Stone Cleaner is an acid-free, phosphate-free, and biodegradable concentrated cleaner ideal for all natural and artificial stones. It effectively removes concrete residue, wax layers, oils, soot, tar, and synthetic stains from marble, granite, tiles, bricks, and cement surfaces. Safe, powerful, and eco-friendly—perfect for deep cleaning stone facades, floors, and cladding.

products.name: Akemi Nano Effect
products.description: AKEMI® Stain Repellent Nano-Effect is a premium, ready-to-use nano-based impregnation solution for natural and artificial stones. It offers powerful protection against oil, grease, water, and graffiti without altering the stone's appearance. With fast action, UV resistance, and food-safe certification, it's perfect for countertops, facades, tiles, and high-traffic areas.

products.name: Akepox 5010
products.description: AKEPOX® 5010 is a high-performance, gel-like two-component epoxy adhesive specially designed for bonding natural stone, ceramics, concrete, and other building materials. It offers excellent weather resistance, low shrinkage, and superior adhesion—even on slightly humid surfaces. Ideal for vertical applications and light-colored stones due to its non-yellowing formulation.

products.name: Kerakoll Bio Tile
products.description: Kerakoll Biotile® is a high-performance, eco-friendly tile adhesive designed for indoor and outdoor wall and floor applications. Suitable for ceramic, terracotta, mosaic, and red clay tiles, it offers excellent adhesion, no sag, and up to 10 mm bed thickness. With very low VOC emissions and recycled content, it's ideal for sustainable residential, commercial, and urban projects.

products.name: Kerakoll H40 No Limit
products.description: Kerakoll H40® No Limits is a highly flexible, multi-purpose, mineral tile adhesive with SAS technology, ideal for vitrified tiles, natural stone, and large-format slabs. Engineered for internal and external use, it offers structural adhesion, zero sag, high deformation resistance, and excellent bond strength—even on critical substrates. Eco-friendly with very low VOC emissions.

products.name: Kerakoll Super Flex Eco
products.description: Kerakoll Superflex is a high-performance, two-component elastic tile adhesive designed for deformable and sensitive substrates. Ideal for porcelain, ceramic tiles, marble, and natural stones, it delivers zero vertical slip, superior flexibility, and excellent bonding on absorbent and non-absorbent surfaces. Perfect for interior/exterior walls, floors, swimming pools, and façades.

products.name: Kerakoll Fugabella Eco Porcelana
products.description: Kerakoll Fugabella® Eco Porcelana 0-5 is a high-performance, color-stable mineral grout for joints up to 5 mm. It offers a scratch-resistant, ultra-fine finish with low water absorption and excellent shade uniformity. Ideal for vitrified tiles, natural stone, mosaics, and low-thickness slabs—perfect for interior and exterior floors and walls.

products.name: Kerakoll Bio Flex
products.description: Kerakoll Bioflex® is a premium mineral tile adhesive designed for high performance bonding of ceramic, porcelain, and natural stone. It offers excellent flexibility, no vertical slip, long open time, and eco-friendly composition with very low VOC emissions. Ideal for indoor and outdoor walls, floors, swimming pools, heated floors, and over existing tiles.

products.name: Kerakoll H40 Gel Grey
products.description: Kerakoll H40® Gel is a multi-purpose, gel-based tile adhesive engineered for high adhesion, structural flexibility, and easy workability. Ideal for ceramic, porcelain, natural stone, and large-format tiles, it performs flawlessly on walls and floors—even in heavy-traffic zones, swimming pools, and facades. Suitable for residential, commercial, and infrastructure projects.

products.name: Kerakoll Bio Fix
products.description: Kerakoll Biofix® is a high-performance, eco-friendly mineral tile adhesive with extremely low VOC emissions and long open time. Ideal for porcelain, ceramic tiles, and natural stone, it ensures superior bonding, no vertical slip, and compatibility with various cementitious and gypsum substrates. Perfect for interior and exterior applications in homes, commercial areas, and urban spaces.
